title: Steiner_Ratio: independent verification of the Gilbert-Pollak certificate layer and a certificate-layer bound of 0.860
description: Independent re-verification of the arXiv:2601.22365 Steiner-ratio certificate layer (330,193,755 records at rho=0.8559, zero failures), and a certificate-layer record: all 1,104,177,103 regions of partitions regenerated at target 0.860 verified non-positive at the exact rational 43/50 (zero defects; 244.1M regions closed over entire boxes). Includes the full paper (LaTeX + PDF), the clean-room Arb verifier, two-seam test suite, content-addressed manifests, curated run records, and reproduction instructions. Upstream (unlicensed) artifacts are not included; reproduction fetches them against pinned sha256s. Contact: aimathpapers@gmail.com
